name: Florence County, SC
findings: Florence County has 368 nonprofit organizations. 136 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Florence County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
